title: The SessionStart hook and /kb-verify still describe the old full gate
goal: .claude/hooks/session_start.py tells a new session the gate is kbgit.py sync with tests.py --changed (no 60 s full-gate claim), /kb-verify says which checks run only when their tests are selected, and test_kb.py's session_start_names_the_focused_gate test fails on the old wording.
notes: Found by the sprint review of SP-ddjk2p5l “Focused gate”: session_start.py still printed the old 60 s full gate with tests.py and stress_test.py for every commit.
